brand.title: Craft Tiki in the
body: The Lobby Tiki Bar brings serious craft cocktail culture to Oceanside's Pier View Way. An extensive rum program, signature tiki drinks, and island-inspired food served in a space that transports you somewhere worth going.
Inside The Brick Hotel, steps from the Oceanside pier. Come for happy hour. Stay for the Cobra Kai.
